purpose: One four-head specialization experiment using the same frozen encoder, scaler, rows, weights and solver; no collection or promotion
scaling: Reuse exactly the shared probe training-only weighted scaler; no fitting on development or per-prefix rescaling
training_mass: Same per-row mass as shared study: each prefix gets one quarter of each flow weight, summing to 14043/4 per head. C=1 unchanged for each head.
routing: Study supplies explicit requested checkpoint; input must have <= checkpoint packets. Default standalone routing chooses smallest checkpoint >= actual length. No future packet access; no claim for intermediate lengths.
evaluation: All four heads fit and full bundle saved before development scoring. Score every available local checkpoint; public short flows use the requested head with actual min(length,budget) prefix, matching training.
quality_gates: Original five forest/B17 checks unchanged. Also require no shared-head mean F1 or per-service mean-recall regression and five-packet local F1 gain >=0.01 over the shared head.
stopping: One numerical-recovery set of four heads at max_iter=2000; stop on any nonconvergence. No winner mixing, shared fallback, C/scaler/seed tuning, calibration, collection or promotion.
limits: Exploratory hypothesis chosen after inspecting reused selection errors. No untouched evaluation or causal live-performance claim. More head parameters and separate L2 penalties are explicit differences.

numerical_recovery.reason: Five-packet head reached 500 iterations before convergence. No development scoring, artifact or remaining head fitting occurred.
numerical_recovery.scope: One pre-score numerical retry. Same solver, C, tolerance, seed, training rows, quarter weights, shared scaler and frozen encoder. Only max_iter changes from 500 to 2000. Preserve the failed attempt.
numerical_recovery.stop: If any head is still nonconverged at 2000, stop without development scoring; no further automatic retry or solver/model change.
